scenarios.title: Quote-scale reference
scenarios.description: A reference path establishes the unscaled percentage.

scenarios.title: Quote-scale invariance
scenarios.description: Multiplying every close by ten preserves BandWidth.

scenarios.title: Squeeze then expansion
scenarios.description: The percentage contracts and later expands.

scenarios.title: Additive-shift contrast
scenarios.description: Adding a constant changes the denominator and therefore the percentage.

scenarios.title: Zero-middle unavailable state
scenarios.description: A zero basis with zero width remains unavailable, not zero.

scenarios.title: Multiplier identity
scenarios.description: Halving the multiplier halves BandWidth for the same mean and dispersion.
